decision_rule.ag_ci_covers_zero_or_negative: No help in this setting; never written as "autoguidance does not work on audio".
decision_rule.ag_ge_gneg: On this model a model-based negative branch can replace the text negative prompt.
decision_rule.combo_ci_lower_gt_0: The AG term is additive to fidelity8.
decision_rule.s1_bad_models: Exploratory only: the difference term also carries the S1/S2 objective mismatch.
decision_rule.unmatched_and_lvl30_disagree: Report as a level effect, not a quality effect (063/065 shape).

analysis.multiple_comparisons: Pointwise 95% bootstrap CIs over paired per-clip deltas; no global significance, no equivalence claim. A CI covering zero is insufficient evidence, not equivalence.
analysis.prespecified_limits: One corpus, one checkpoint family (nmv2pair quarter), one generation seed (42); pilot selection on one training seed. Only the "trained shorter" axis of Karras-style bad models is used (same size EMA snapshots), close to the final (110k/130k vs 150k); a null does not extrapolate to the original method. CLAP/AES are not human judgments; MeanFlow 25 steps is a few-step regime.
analysis.primary_endpoint: Selected pure cell vs stock cfg0 on the same MusicCaps rows: paired dPQ after -30 LUFS matching, read against the text-negative gain G_neg (stock cfg3_neg - stock cfg0, lvl30) on the same clips.
analysis.secondary_endpoint: Selected combo cell vs stock cfg3_neg: paired lvl30 dPQ (is the AG term additive to the fidelity8 negative prompt?).
analysis.selection_rule: Pure: the pilot cell with the largest lvl30 dPQ vs stock cfg0 subject to dCLAP >= -0.005. Combo: largest lvl30 dPQ vs stock cfg3_neg subject to the same floor. If no cell clears the floor, the best dPQ is promoted anyway so the null is measured on three seeds rather than assumed.
analysis.silence_flag_rule: silent_n more than 2x the stock reference on the same clips is flagged (project_slot0nm_silence_mode precedent).
analysis.stage_c_rule: A selected cell is generated at 5521 rows on s14159265 only if its lvl30 dPQ CI lower bound is > 0 against its reference on all 3 training seeds and its dCLAP >= -0.005 on all 3.

completion_evidence.note: Eval-only job: the guest writes its own terminal evidence (evidence.eval_only true) and never claims a training artifact. Per QUEUE.md the terminal's evidence.reports paths must equal this contract's reports paths with matching sha256.
